title: Low-Dose 68 Ga-PSMA Prostate PET/MRI Imaging Using Deep Learning Based on MRI Priors.
summary: In 41 patients, image quality and physician scoring improved over low-dose source images; diagnosis was reported unaffected at reduced dose. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: Deep learning using MRI priors synthesized full-dose-like PSMA PET from low-dose images.
organization: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: In 41 patients, image quality and physician scoring improved over low-dose source images; diagnosis was reported unaffected at reduced dose.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning using MRI priors synthesized full-dose-like PSMA PET from low-dose images.
